title: Keep project ownership separate
when: When the requested outcome touches multiple project repositories or changes a reusable producer contract.
need: Each project retains its own item and lane; companion items express a real cross-project dependency and exact consumer proof. Related does not automatically mean shared deployment.
surface: Intake cross-project handling; project/document steering scope
gap: JOURNEYS 14 says link them but lacks a beginner procedure. Review question: should its guide distinguish shared context, dependent work and shared delivery as separate needs?
